answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested payouts: each agent earns rewards that stream out over many epochs, so a freshly forged identity must survive dozens of payout periods before its signal contribution is fully paid. Fake accounts flashing into a task reef and vanishing forfeit nearly everything already earned, since unvested balances burn on exit. An attacker must therefore pay the real cost the system prices in: long-lived honest participation per identity, making bulk fake agents unprofitable.
